title: What is MatchBox?
body: What is MatchBox? MatchBox is an independent Rust implementation of the BoxLang language and runtime. It brings BoxLang to native binaries, browser and server-side WebAssembly, and embedded targets without requiring a JVM for its core runtime. BoxLang is a software productivity platform for building, modernizing, and running applications, with developers and AI agents working together. MatchBox is…
